headline: Sula Vineyards Q2 profit rises 35% as premium wine sales grow
hook: Premium sales drive Sula's quarterly profit jump
summary: Sula Vineyards reported a net profit of ₹8 crore for Q2 FY27, marking a 35% increase compared to the same period last year. Revenue for the quarter grew 3.5% to ₹135.5 crore, supported by strong performance in premium wine segments and wine tourism. The company board has approved a strategic expansion into de-alcoholised wines and the development of a new hotel at York Winery. These initiatives will be executed through its subsidiary, Artisan Spirits.
why_it_matters: Premium segment growth signals sustained demand for Sula's core products.

headline: Sula Vineyards releases latest investor presentation
hook: Sula Vineyards updates investors on business performance
summary: Sula Vineyards has filed its latest investor presentation with the NSE. The document provides details on the company's operational performance and strategic outlook. Retail investors can review these slides to understand the firm's current market positioning and growth trajectory.
why_it_matters: Provides transparency on company growth and operational strategy.

headline: Sula Vineyards releases financial results for Q2 FY27
hook: Sula Vineyards reports September quarter financials
summary: Sula Vineyards Limited has officially filed its financial results for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, with the NSE. The filing provides the latest performance data for the company during the second quarter of the fiscal year. Retail investors can access the detailed balance sheet and profit and loss statement via the exchange portal to assess the company's current operational health.
why_it_matters: Quarterly earnings data helps assess Sula's current valuation and growth.
